overview: Rose in Vale is an adults-only country house hotel set in ten acres of gardens in the hamlet of Mithian, inland from St Agnes. It has 22 rooms and suites plus a self-catering studio, a restaurant and bar, and a seasonal outdoor pool, with Trevaunance Cove and Perranporth beach both a short drive away.
surfTripFit: It works for couples who want a quiet, comfortable base between St Agnes and Perranporth, but you will need to drive to the beach and it is no good for families or dogs.
